fixturegen.notes: The Go fixture generator. Payload synthesis, every byte edit, and the zip, tar, gzip, DEFLATE, zstd, bzip2 and brotli containers are Go; RAR comes only from RARLAB's own writer, PAR2 from par2cmdline-turbo, PAR3 from the par3cmdline reference, 7z from the official 7-Zip console binary and video from the pinned FFmpeg image. Not byte-reproducible as a whole: RAR and 7z stamp creation times and draw encryption salts, and the video encoders are not bit-exact across builds. The zip, tar and stream-codec families are byte-reproducible from their recipe alone.
